summary: The local stdio adapter exposes the memory tool set and has source-level transport and degraded-mode tests.
worksToday: Initializes over stdio and lists the expected memory tools.
Supports an explicit degraded mode when embeddings are unavailable.
limitations: Normal operation depends on a reachable compatible Ollama model.
No clean-installed task through a real external MCP client has been reviewed.
supportedEnvironments: Windows source build; portable Rust implementation
installation: Build from source with cargo build -p elegy-memory-mcp --bin elegy-memory-mcp-stdio.
invocation: Set ELEGY_DB_PATH and embedding provider variables, then run elegy-memory-mcp-stdio.
